notable_absence.finding: This overview page enumerates the whole node-management task list (initialize, provision, add/remove, failover, rebalance, recover, modify-services, node-to-node encryption, address family) in one bullet list but states no RBAC role requirement anywhere on the page itself - each individual task page (read separately in this batch) turns out to carry its own, page-local role/edition/version gating instead. The overview is a pure table-of-contents page with almost no independent ontological content of its own.

cross_component_finding: This page is the batch's front door and explicitly frames 'rebalancing the cluster' as occurring 'after a node has been removed for scheduled or otherwise planned maintenance' - i.e. the overview's own mental model already treats rebalance as a single recurring consequence of several different antecedent admin operations (add, remove, modify-services), not as several different kinds of rebalance. This framing is confirmed by every other page in the batch: see the cross_component_finding on add-node-and-rebalance and modify-services-and-rebalance for the detailed evidence.
